name: agent-bus
description: The agent bus beside the transcript: /bus opens a pane of queued, running and recent tasks with their results, a running count rides the status line, and a task this session dispatched reports back to it when it finishes.

hosts.title: Bus machines
hosts.description: The buses the pane watches, in order, separated by commas: "local" for this machine's, or an ssh alias ("imac", "mini") for another machine's, reached as ssh <alias> '~/.local/bin/agent-dispatch …'. The first is where New task dispatches by default.
